Hi Jillian — welcome, and thanks for the packet. Quick answers below; looping in Marissa (procurement) and Aditya (finance) to confirm final steps.

Short answers:
- Yes, we can issue provisional PO numbers scoped to feature streams. We typically create a parent PO and then append suffixes for tracked sub-allocations (e.g., PO-8721-1, PO-8721-2).
- We support spend caps with automated holds: when 90% of the cap is reached we notify both parties; at 100% the order is put into a HOLD state until a manual release is approved by Redwood procurement.
- For invoice splitting we ask vendors to reference the exact sub-PO suffix and include the line-item code in the invoice description — that keeps our ledger clean.

Marissa / Aditya — can we provision PO-8721-1 for the initial onboarding SOW at $85,000 cap and a sibling PO-8721-2 for professional services at $25,000? Vendor prefers separate POs for accounting.

Jillian — I also uploaded your onboarding form to our shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-onboarding (you should have access).

Best,
Karthik

Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — I can take this. A couple of procurement notes and a proposed plan: 

1) Proposed PO issuance pattern:
   - Parent contract: PO-8721 (contract-level reference)
   - Sub-allocations: PO-8721-01 (platform usage) — $85,000 cap
                      PO-8721-02 (professional services) — $25,000 cap
   - We will mark both as provisional until the signed SOW is attached.

2) Spend gating behavior:
   - Our system will send automated email alerts at 85% and 95%. At 100% it toggles a hold flag. Release requires procurement sign-off (Marissa) + finance confirmation (Aditya).

3) Line-item mapping rules for vendor invoices:
   - Vendors must include: sub-PO (PO-8721-01), Redwood line code (e.g., RDW-SVC-101), and the vendor's invoice line number.
   - If a vendor submits a single invoice that needs to be split across sub-POs, we do a remittance mapping but we prefer vendors send two separate invoices to avoid AR reconciliation work on our side.

4) Attachments: I will create the provisional PO PDFs and upload them to the folder.

Action items:
- Aditya: confirm GL coding for PO-8721-01/02 (suggest RW-INF-PLAT and RW-INF-PS).
- Karthik: confirm vendor-side that separate invoices are acceptable.
- Jillian: send us the signed SOW or let us know if the SOW needs redlines.

I'll generate provisional PO PDFs and route for internal approvals this afternoon.
